noteText: Proposed blocked release. Every entry—including AI—checks loaded site, latest saved revision, permissions and existing review requirements. Figma never starts deployment or claims a provider connection succeeded. Final release confirmation is a separate state.

noteText: IN-01 / Image content

Existing image source/alt/Fit/Loading are reorganized under Content. No Typography or generic Layout for image. RT-01 media persistence and honest cloud/local state remain engineering dependencies. Replace returns to this selection.

noteText: IN-02 / Container · Flex

Existing container Layout controls: Flex, direction, alignment, wrap and gap. Native values must reflect effective breakpoint/state; R-09 and UX-10/25 remain engineering checks. Dedicated flex/stack types reuse controls without duplicate Layout.
IN-03 / Container · Grid

Existing Grid controls retained, including custom tracks, rows and flow. Count is only used for countable grids; auto-fit/auto-fill must remain custom. More settings disclosure must retain authored advanced values.
IN-04 / Form content and submission

Fields and After submit moved from Behaviour to Content. Server settings save immediately outside document Undo; Send to is Admin-only. This snapshot shows editable Admin context, not proof of submission delivery.

noteText: IN-05 / CMS-bound heading

Direct CMS binding limited to six eligible leaf types. Collection/field/record and caller return preserved. Missing-source state needs Reconnect/Unbind. CMS record/schema management stays in CMS; no binding success inferred.

Instance banner and underlying type remain visible. Existing Variant/Edit master/Reset/Detach contracts preserved; layout and Text inside follow actual override restrictions. Persistence, reset confirmation and failure recovery remain engineering work.

Heading + image + container share only applicable generic controls. Mixed values are explicit; group requires common writable parent and one transaction. CI-01 scope-aware alignment/lock checks remain required.

noteText: IN-09 / Context menu · viewport edge

Proposed lower-right menu and left-opening submenu stay within viewport. Arrange means sibling order, not CSS z-index. Paste style explains unavailable clipboard. MENU-01/R-07 keyboard, target freezing and shared eligibility require validation.
IN-10 / Canvas · valid drop target

Proposed valid drop feedback identifies parent and insertion order. Native drag evidence is incomplete; CAN-01–03/R-01–03 require coordinate, nesting, cancellation and history validation. Invalid destination variant must show a concrete reason, not a success cue.

noteText: IN-11 / Canvas · resize state

Proposed resize readout and property values use the same authored CSS dimensions. CAN-01–03 require finite keyboard values, zoom/scroll conversion, isolated Escape cancellation and one Undo transaction. Static design is not runtime proof.
